entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Jane Doe, order 774-V-901.

Thank you, Jane. I'm pulling that up now... I see you have the VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered on December 17th, about 15 days ago. To make sure I'm on the right track, is it a technical fault or is this more of a preference issue?
I just changed my mind.
I understand. And just to confirm, there's nothing wrong with the device itself? It's tracking and syncing correctly?
It's fine. I just don't use it. It was an impulse buy.

Okay, thank you for clarifying. For our VeloBand Pulse model specifically, we have a strict 10-day return policy due to the way the hardware activates and links to a personal account, as well as for hygiene protocols. Since we're on day 15, I'm afraid I can't process a return for a refund on this item.
Right. Of course. Figures.
I do understand the situation isn't ideal, but I do have an alternative solution that many of our customers use. We have an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace.
And what is that?

It’s a platform we host for VeloFit users to sell their gently used gear to other community members. Since your band is practically new, you'd likely be able to recoup most of what you paid for it. It's the best option for resale since it's targeted directly at people looking for our products.
So you're saying I have to sell it myself. Great.

It is the best option we can provide outside the 10-day policy window. It’s a secure way to ensure the device goes to another VeloFit enthusiast. I can send you a direct link to the marketplace homepage if you'd like?
Whatever. Fine. Send the link.
Okay, I've just sent that email to the address on your account. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No. That's everything.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a good day.
